content.outro: The party climbs out of the race into the mill yard. Behind them the three paddles keep rising and falling on the wheel's count, for nobody.
content.premise: The tide mill at Saltmarsh Reach has had no miller for years, but its wheel still turns on the ebb, and the wheel still works the three paddle gates in the dry race below it. The only way up to the mill yard from the sea wall is along that race, through the paddles, each one quicker than the last.
content.theme: A mill race whose three paddle gates rise and fall on the wheel's count, each window shorter than the one before.
content.title: The Tide Mill
